## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Layout uses logical properties only (no hard-coded left/right) and works in Arabic (RTL)
- [ ] User-facing text exists in French, English and Arabic (English is required)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or invented personal data
- [ ] Docs updated; an ADR added if this is a significant decision
